AV_FRAME_DATA_A53_CC - com.avpkit.core.IVideoPicture.FrameDataType
ATSC A53 Part 4 Closed Captions.
A53 CC bitstream is stored as uint8_t in AVFrameSideData.data.
The number of bytes of CC data is AVFrameSideData.size.
AV_FRAME_DATA_AFD - com.avpkit.core.IVideoPicture.FrameDataType
Active Format Description data consisting of a single byte as specified
in ETSI TS 101 154 using AVActiveFormatDescription enum.
AV_FRAME_DATA_AUDIO_SERVICE_TYPE - com.avpkit.core.IVideoPicture.FrameDataType
This side data must be associated with an audio frame and corresponds to
enum AVAudioServiceType defined in avcodec.h.
AV_FRAME_DATA_CONTENT_LIGHT_LEVEL - com.avpkit.core.IVideoPicture.FrameDataType
Content light level (based on CTA-861.3).
AV_FRAME_DATA_DISPLAYMATRIX - com.avpkit.core.IVideoPicture.FrameDataType
This side data contains a 3x3 transformation matrix describing an affine
transformation that needs to be applied to the frame for correct
presentation.

See libavutil/display.h for a detailed description of the data.
AV_FRAME_DATA_DOWNMIX_INFO - com.avpkit.core.IVideoPicture.FrameDataType
Metadata relevant to a downmix procedure.
The data is the AVDownmixInfo struct defined in libavutil/downmix_info.h.
AV_FRAME_DATA_GOP_TIMECODE - com.avpkit.core.IVideoPicture.FrameDataType
The GOP timecode in 25 bit timecode format.
AV_FRAME_DATA_ICC_PROFILE - com.avpkit.core.IVideoPicture.FrameDataType
The data contains an ICC profile as an opaque octet buffer following the
format described by ISO 15076-1 with an optional name defined in the
metadata key entry "name".
AV_FRAME_DATA_MASTERING_DISPLAY_METADATA - com.avpkit.core.IVideoPicture.FrameDataType
Mastering display metadata associated with a video frame.
AV_FRAME_DATA_MATRIXENCODING - com.avpkit.core.IVideoPicture.FrameDataType
The data is the AVMatrixEncoding enum defined in libavutil/channel_layout.h.
AV_FRAME_DATA_MOTION_VECTORS - com.avpkit.core.IVideoPicture.FrameDataType
Motion vectors exported by some codecs (on demand through the export_mvs
flag set in the libavcodec AVCodecContext flags2 option).
The data is the AVMotionVector struct defined in
libavutil/motion_vector.h.
AV_FRAME_DATA_PANSCAN - com.avpkit.core.IVideoPicture.FrameDataType
The data is the AVPanScan struct defined in libavcodec.
AV_FRAME_DATA_REPLAYGAIN - com.avpkit.core.IVideoPicture.FrameDataType
ReplayGain information in the form of the AVReplayGain struct.
AV_FRAME_DATA_SKIP_SAMPLES - com.avpkit.core.IVideoPicture.FrameDataType
Recommmends skipping the specified number of samples.
AV_FRAME_DATA_SPHERICAL - com.avpkit.core.IVideoPicture.FrameDataType
The data represents the AVSphericalMapping structure defined in
libavutil/spherical.h.
AV_FRAME_DATA_STEREO3D - com.avpkit.core.IVideoPicture.FrameDataType
Stereoscopic 3d metadata.
The data is the AVStereo3D struct defined in libavutil/stereo3d.h.
